bar.outputs.outcome: A bar appears on every connected output, including outputs connected later

bar.power_screen.outcome: Left click on the power control opens the power screen

bar.power_menu.outcome: The power control's quick-action menu offers suspend, hibernate, shutdown, reboot and logout, each running its session action

bar.app_menu.outcome: Left click on the menu control toggles the selected application launcher

bar.tools_menu.outcome: The menu control's right-click menu offers Application Launcher, View Keybinds, Open Keybind Config and Take Snapshot

bar.tray.outcome: Status-notifier tray items are shown and receive their own clicks

bar.workspaces.outcome: Hyprland workspaces are listed in numeric order and a click activates one

bar.submap.outcome: The active Hyprland submap is visible and hidden in the default map

bar.audio.outcome: Output and microphone volume/mute are shown; left click opens application volumes, right click the device mixer

bar.backlight.outcome: Screen brightness is shown and scrolling adjusts it; absent backlight is shown as unavailable

bar.backlight_presets.outcome: A right-click menu sets brightness to 100, 75, 50, 25 or 10 percent

bar.temperature.outcome: CPU temperature is shown with a critical state; left click opens the system monitor

bar.battery.outcome: Battery capacity, charging and warning/critical states are shown; absent battery is shown as unavailable

bar.network.outcome: Network state is shown; left click chooses a network, right click edits connection profiles

bar.bluetooth.outcome: Bluetooth controller, power and connection state are shown (no controller is distinct from off); left click opens devices, right click toggles the radio

bar.updates.outcome: The pending update count is shown and left click starts a confirmed system update

bar.updates_menu.outcome: A right-click menu offers check, update, update without AUR, firmware, pacnew review, cache cleaning and the update log

bar.notifications.outcome: Notification state (waiting count, do-not-disturb, inhibition, stopped, unavailable) is shown from observed status; left click runs the provider's primary notification gesture (SwayNC control center, otherwise dismiss all), right click toggles do-not-disturb

bar.theme_control.outcome: The current dark/light variant is shown and a click switches it

bar.clock.outcome: Date and time are shown with the configured format; left click opens the selected calendar

bar.unavailable_hardware.outcome: Absent battery, backlight, lock-key LEDs or Bluetooth controller stay visible as unavailable, distinct from off, error or stale

bar.appearance.outcome: The bar follows the dark/light theme (Catppuccin Mocha/Latte, Noto Sans, modest rounding, subtle translucency) with readable normal, hover, focus, warning, critical, muted and unavailable states

dock.appearance.outcome: The dock follows the dark/light theme with a readable focused-application indicator

dock.none.outcome: With dock None no dock process starts, dock launches succeed as no-ops and no pin or panel state is written

dock.pins.outcome: Pinned applications are shown; initial pins follow the primary terminal, browser, file manager and enabled GUI editor without overwriting existing pins

dock.launch_focus.outcome: Activating an application launches it when it is not running and focuses its window when it is

dock.follow_focus.outcome: The dock follows the focused output (otherwise it stays on a fixed primary output and this capability is unsupported)

bar/waybar.summary: All bar controls, menus and status are native Waybar modules; dark/light control included.
limitations: Lock-key state needs the input group; without it the bar shows an explicit 'cannot read' state
The update count needs waybar-module-pacman-updates (installed with Waybar)
bar/waybar.data_boundary: Bar configuration and theme colors only; no notification content, SSIDs or addresses are stored.

bar.power_menu.note: Waybar menu; confirmations come from the session provider

bar.workspaces.note: Real Hyprland activation is a VM check

bar.submap.note: Real Hyprland submap is a VM check

bar.lock_keys.note: Needs read access to /dev/input (input group); otherwise the bar shows an explicit denied state

bar.updates.note: Needs waybar-module-pacman-updates; hidden when it is not installed

bar.notifications.note: Custom module adapter over status_read.sh notifications; SwayNC streams natively

bar.appearance.note: Colors imported from a generated file; SIGUSR2 reload

theme.note: Colors import from a generated file; Waybar reloads on SIGUSR2.

bar/ironbar.summary: All controls and menus work (popups through Ironbar IPC); microphone level and a fixed time zone are missing.
limitations: The microphone level is not shown on the bar
The clock follows the system time zone
With several outputs, a right-click menu opens on every bar
bar/ironbar.data_boundary: Bar configuration and theme colors only; no notification content, SSIDs or addresses are stored.

bar.power_menu.note: Custom popup opened through Ironbar IPC; with several outputs it opens on every bar

bar.workspaces.note: Click activation verified on sway; Hyprland is a VM check

bar.submap.note: bindmode verified with sway modes; Hyprland submaps from source

bar.audio.note: Output volume and both gestures are native; the microphone level is not shown on the bar

bar.backlight.note: Label from sysfs with scroll adjustment; absent backlight shows n/a

bar.lock_keys.note: Label from the kernel LED class (no input group needed)

bar.battery.note: UPower battery module with warning/critical profiles plus an n/a label when no battery exists

bar.updates.note: Watch-mode label over the existing update producer

bar.notifications.note: Watch-mode script adapter; the native module is SwayNC-only and would D-Bus-activate SwayNC

bar.clock.note: Left click opens the selected calendar; the clock follows the system time zone (no time-zone option)

bar.appearance.note: Generated GTK4 stylesheet; reloaded with ironbar style load-css

theme.note: Theme switches reload the stylesheet with 'ironbar style load-css'.

bar/nwg-panel.summary: Status, clicks and the theme control work; nwg-panel has no right-click menus.
limitations: Power quick actions, the tools menu, brightness presets and update options are not available from the bar (no right-click menus)
The update count is not shown (executors cannot stream it)
Theme changes apply the next time the panel starts (no style reload)
bar/nwg-panel.data_boundary: Panel configuration, pinned desktop files and theme colors only.

bar.outputs.note: output 'All' clones the bar; hotplug restarts the panel process

bar.power_menu.note: nwg-panel buttons and executors have no right-click menus; the controls popup is not used because it adds a SwayNC widget

bar.workspaces.note: Hyprland real effect is a VM check

bar.submap.note: Updates only because workspaces are in the same panel

bar.audio.note: Executor over status_read.sh audio; refreshes every 3 s

bar.backlight.note: Executor from sysfs with scroll adjustment

bar.lock_keys.note: Executor from the kernel LED class

bar.battery.note: Executor from sysfs; the controls battery is not used (it reports 0% and warns without a battery)

bar.updates.note: Left click starts the confirmed update; the update count needs a streaming widget, which executors are not

bar.notifications.note: Executor over status_read.sh notifications (3 s polling)

bar.clock.note: Executor clock: the native clock has no left-click command or time zone

bar.appearance.note: Applies at the next panel start (no style reload)

theme.note: Applies at the next panel start; the shared process is never restarted for a theme change.

dock/nwg-dock-hyprland.summary: Pins, running apps, launch-or-focus and active indicator work; the dock stays on the output where it started.
limitations: Does not follow the focused output
Theme changes apply the next time the dock starts; running-indicator images keep their upstream colors
dock/nwg-dock-hyprland.data_boundary: Pinned window classes in $XDG_CACHE_HOME/nwg-dock-pinned; never imported from other tools.

dock.pins.note: Seeded once into $XDG_CACHE_HOME/nwg-dock-pinned as window classes

dock.launch_focus.note: Requires the pin to equal the window class; VS Code launches through desktop-file matching (VM check)

dock.follow_focus.note: The dock stays on the output where it started (fixed primary output)

dock.appearance.note: CSS is read only at startup; running-indicator images keep their upstream colors

theme.note: CSS is read only at startup; indicator images are not CSS.

dock/nwg-panel.summary: Pinned apps and a taskbar with focus and active indicator; pins always launch new windows.
limitations: A pinned app always starts a new instance; focus a running window with its taskbar button
Stays on the primary output (does not follow focus)
Theme changes apply the next time the panel starts
dock/nwg-panel.data_boundary: Pinned desktop files in $XDG_CACHE_HOME/nwg-pin-cache (shared with other nwg tools).

dock.pins.note: pinned module reads seeded $XDG_CACHE_HOME/nwg-pin-cache desktop files

dock.launch_focus.note: Pins always launch a new instance; a running window is focused through its taskbar button

dock.follow_focus.note: The dock panel stays on output 0 (fixed primary output)

dock.appearance.note: Shares the nwg-panel stylesheet; applies at the next panel start

theme.note: Shares the nwg-panel unit with the bar.

dock.behavior: No dock starts: role_exec.sh dock and nwg_dock.sh exit 0 without writing pins or panel configuration; the bar and its toggle are unaffected.
